tl-radish.why: 42 g on a 1020 tray. About 21 g on a 10 by 10.

tl-pea.why: 150 g on a 1020 tray. About 75 g on a 10 by 10.

tl-broccoli.why: 28 g on a 1020 tray. Check that the bag covers that weight.

tl-sunflower.why: 48 g on a 1020 tray, after a soak. Check the bag.

tl-kits.why: Mini kits are in this collection. Check what the kit includes.

hm-daikon-radish.why: Organic daikon radish seed for a first tray.

hm-broccoli.why: Organic broccoli seed for a microgreen tray.
